shap_explainability.Tool_wear_failure: High SHAP values for Tool_wear_min. When tool wear exceeds 200 mins, risk of TWF spikes.
shap_explainability.Heat_dissipation_failure: High SHAP values for the difference between Process and Air temperatures. Lower temperature difference reduces dissipation capability, causing failure.
shap_explainability.Power_failure: Driven by the product of Torque and Rotational speed. Very high or very low power leads to PWF.
shap_explainability.Overstrain_failure: Driven by the product of Tool wear and Torque. High torque and high tool wear cause OSF.
